# Poly Pizza asset inventory

These are source models downloaded for the Christmas Market Roblox project on
2026-11-20. Each source page was checked before download and marked **CC0 1.0
(Public Domain)**. The assets may be used and modified without attribution.

Do not put these raw files directly in `src/`: import and validate them in
Roblox Studio first. The imported model must still follow the project asset
contract in `docs/MODEL_INTEGRATION.md` (correct scale, pivot, collision and
attachments). No source model contains Roblox scripts.

| Folder | Model | Intended project use | Source | Original format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trees-pine-trees` | Pine Trees — Quaternius | Tree stock / snowy scenery | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/oYtDty0fR6) | FBX |
| `trees-pine` | Pine — Quaternius | Tree stock / snowy scenery | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/79gmlLnweB) | FBX |
| `market-stand` | Market Stand | `StarterSalesTent` reference | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/DGIM5HGISb) | FBX |
| `market-stalls` | Market Stalls — Quaternius | `ChristmasPavilion` reference | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/jSqGy8V0MQ) | FBX |
| `market-stalls-compact` | Market Stalls Compact — Quaternius | Alternate small sales stand | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/fmHUuX9AS3) | FBX |
| `supplier-truck` | Truck — Quaternius | `SupplierTruck` reference | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/cXw6oiFtZ8) | GLB |
| `basic-fence` | Fence | `BasicFence` reference | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/e02PFKKhbr) | OBJ + MTL |
| `tree-lights` | Tree Light — Quaternius | `FestiveLights` reference | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/om4BJAL82T) | FBX |
| `presents` | Present — Quaternius | Seasonal decoration / prop | [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/m/LVg3ynJDxa) | FBX |

Folders contain the unpacked original model, committed byte-for-byte (see
`.gitattributes`). The redundant `source.zip` download packages stay out of Git
(`.gitignore`); re-download them from the source page above when needed. Poly
Pizza does not offer an archive for `supplier-truck`; `Truck.glb` is its direct
original download.
